# ngrok documentation: Errors / Named error codes

## Named error codes

- [ERR_NGROK_AGENT_INVALID_REQUEST: The agent request is invalid: REASON](https://ngrok.com/docs/errors/err_ngrok_agent_invalid_request.md)
- [ERR_NGROK_AGENT_NOT_FOUND: Agent ID was not found](https://ngrok.com/docs/errors/err_ngrok_agent_not_found.md)
